description: This file defines the TileView class, a custom Android View for handling and rendering a grid of drawable tiles, used in a Snake game application.

classes.name: TileView
classes.description: A custom View for managing and drawing a grid of drawable tiles, with methods to load, set, and clear tiles, and handle size changes.

methods.name: TileView
methods.description: Constructor initializing TileView with context and attributes, setting tile size from style attributes.

methods.name: clearTiles
methods.description: Resets all tiles in the grid to 0 (empty).

methods.name: loadTile
methods.description: Loads a Drawable as a tile into the tile array at a specified key.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the visible tiles onto the canvas based on the current grid.

methods.name: resetTiles
methods.description: Initializes the internal bitmap array to a specified size.

methods.name: setTile
methods.description: Sets a specific tile index at given x, y coordinates in the grid.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles view size changes, recalculates tile counts and offsets, and resets the tile grid.
